summary:
# SETTLING DAY — by Nat Gould (Gutenberg #35496; Australian bush/Turf novel, c.1901, R.A. Everett & Co.)

Front matter: Press opinions for Sporting Sketches, A Racecourse Tragedy, Warned Off. Other Gould/Everett titles listed at back (Double Event, Outridden, Judas of To-day, etc.) — ignore for Q&A.

## CHARACTERS
- **Jim Dennis**: owner of Wanabeen station (NSW, near Swamp Creek). Big, powerful, inscrutable, honest but feared/distrusted by locals; expert horseman/breaker; mare **Bess**; bay stallion-bred horse. Wronged by wife.
- **Willie (Little Chap) Dennis**: son, 6 at start (ch1), 12 later. Jockey; yellow jacket, red cap; rides Neptune.
- **Maud Dennis**: Jim's city-bred wife; deserted Wanabeen (went to Sydney, then England with Rodney Shaw); later returns dying, dies at Wanabeen with Willie holding hand. Jim forgives her, keeps Willie from knowing she's his mother.
- **Sal (Black Sal)**: half-caste, ~24–25, ex-mission girl, fled; found by Jim on his steps, 3 yrs before ch2; devoted to Willie ("mother"). Brown liquid eyes, curly hair. Later marries Sergeant Doonan.
- **Dr Tom (Thomas) Sheridan / "Dr Tom"**: Swamp Creek doctor, ex-ship's surgeon, drinks, idolised, poor fee-payer; secretary/starter for races; dog **Baalim** (ugly half-dingo, kangaroo dog); wrote bad poems; black boy (~40) helper; buggy with bad horses.
- **Rodney Shaw**: wealthy squatter of **Cudgegong** station (~30–40 sq miles); returned from England; villain; stole/kidnapped Maud, later abducts Sal; shot by Doonan; dies of bleeding at Cudgegong. Stallion **Seahorse** (by Fisherman out of Mermaid). Manager **Benjamin (Ben) Nix**. Race colours green jacket/white cap; second string black cap.
- **Abe Dalton**: outlaw, head of gang at **Barker's Creek**; attacked Willie with pestle; shot black gin; killed Sergeant Machinson; captured after Adye Dauntsey shoots his hand.
- **Seth Sharp**: murderer (Ned Glenn's killer), gang member, captured.
- **Sergeant Machinson**: corrupt police sergeant at Barragong; takes Dalton's bribes; dies at Barker's Creek.
- **Constable Fred Doonan**: honest, Jim's friend; later Sergeant, marries Sal.
- **Adye Dauntsey**: police magistrate at Barragong; Dr Tom's friend.
- **Ned Glenn**: coach driver (Swamp Creek–Bourke); shot dead by Seth Sharp during coach robbery (~ch20).
- **Samuel (Sam) Potter**: publican at Potter's Shanty; illiterate; acquitted of forgery.
- **Aaron Hyam**: bookmaker/publican, Gum Tree Hotel; son Moses.
- **Ben Madsley**: jockey, rode Distant Shore.
- **Jackson**: jockey on Dalton's The Captain; foul rider.
- **Alec Beg**: Rodney's shifty hand.
- **Silas Dixon**: surly Wanabeen hand.
- **King Charlie**: old tribal chief (Woolloola camp); metal half-moon badge; cursed Sal; later leads tribe at Barker's Creek.
- **Molly Corbold**: Adye Dauntsey's cousin; later Jim's second wife.
- **Chris Shaw**: Rodney's cousin; inherits Cudgegong, sells to Jim for £12,000.
- **Price James**: bookmaker friend.
- **Jack Ashton**: crack jockey on Defiance (Sydney Cup); **Hurley**: rode Target.
- **Ben Madsley**, **Jones** (rode Tatters), **Alf Sniggers** (owes Dr Tom a bullock).

## PART ONE: SWAMP CREEK / WANABEEN (ch1–5)
1. Jim rides Bess to Swamp Creek; Willie (6) dying of fever. Dr Tom, driving buggy, reaches Wanabeen; Willie saved. Jim: "Thank God." Jim's bad luck "curse."
2. Sal (found on steps, lay down to die; Jim carried her in) cared for Willie. King Charlie's tribe; Sal "bolted" from mission. Dr Tom: Jim owes him. Jim: "Settling Day" re Willie's mother.
3. Potter's Shanty robbery of bank agent (Nation's Bank, Swamp Creek, manager en route to Bourke) — Jim suspected; £5 note cashed. Ned Glenn (pro-Jim, cheeky, in Sydney Lantern cartoon). Ned: "I hope I'll live to see him on the back of a cup winner."
4. Maud left Jim, deserted child for Sydney/England, slandered Jim, disowned Willie. Jim vowed "settling day," hardened heart, swore Willie would never hear mother's name. Jim breaks in horses; thinks Willie a jockey. Sal's devotion.
5. Storm; strange stallion (Seahorse) runs into Jim's yard; Jim whips it; Constable Doonan arrives. Sergeant Machinson hostile. Rodney Shaw back from England.
6. Rodney Shaw described (wealthy, domineering, once vicious). Jim rides to Cudgegong (15 miles); Machinson accompanies; Rodney cold, frightened.
7. Rodney's man Alec Beg says horse stolen at Potter's. Dalton's men return for horse; Sal tells Jim. Jim (with 6-shot revolver) catches thieves near Barker's Creek, takes horse, rides to Cudgegong. Dalton men unarmed.
8. Jim at Cudgegong verandah at 2am; Rodney drunk, frightened; memory loss claim ("hurdle race spill"); Jim gives Adye Dauntsey name; Rodney writes on chair back. Jim offers mares for Seahorse.
9. Dr Tom's poem story (ship's skipper, fiery beard); Dr Tom threatens Dalton via Doonan talk.
10. Dr Tom at Barker's Creek; frightens Abe Dalton (fever); Dalton swears no gang harm to Jim. Gang member says Machinson takes Dalton's bribes.

## PART TWO: RACE PREP (ch11–16)
11. Willie 12, Neptune (grey, by Seahorse, dam La Perouse, 16hh, temper). Rodney wants Sal. Dr Tom: "Try Willie."
12. Dr Tom's dog Baalim; Willie to ride Neptune; Dr Tom's "settling" musings.
13. Swamp Creek Cup: £200 + silver cup. Bookmaker Aaron Hyam; favourite First Class (9st7); Rodney's Distant Shore (Madsley) & Seaweed; Dalton's The Captain (3yo). Dr Tom bets £20 vs The Captain; Dalton insults Willie ("half-caste"); Dr Tom flings him off.
14. Ned Glenn tells Jim Dr Tom saved Dalton's life on condition gang leaves Jim alone. Sal warns "You have a bad friend... Rodney Shaw!" Legend of King Charlie ("You are cursed").
15. Eve of race: Willie at Dr Tom's; Dalton hits Willie on head with pestle. Dalton asks Rodney what Sal bounty: £100 on delivery (Rodney). Dr Tom and Jim find Willie unconscious.
16. Morning of race; Willie OK-ish. Adye Dauntsey; Machinson; Jim tells P.M. of Seth Sharp at Barker's Creek; Rodney sees Willie.

## PART THREE: THE RACE (ch17–19)
17. Track, runners (14), Willie's yellow jacket/red cap. Jim's advice. Jackson's rough start.
18. Race: Neptune wide; Willie sits still; wins by short head over Distant Shore. Jim bets Rodney £50; Aaron Hyam covers.
19. Dr Tom declares foul play. Sal finds Rodney; sees Abe Dalton; warns him ("King Charlie is not yet dead").

## PART FOUR: ABDUCTION, BARKER'S CREEK (ch20–24)
20. Jim & Dr Tom go to Barragong. Dalton's men (four) kidnap Sal; Silas warns Doonan's location via Willie. Ned Glenn shot dead in coach holdup by Seth Sharp (Dalton's gang), three miles from Swamp Creek.
21. Dalton's men raid Wanabeen; Sal shoots, is pinioned; black gin killed by Dalton with revolver. Sal taken to Cudgegong; Rodney pays £20 extra. Sal escapes via termite-eaten floor (ch21 end).
22. Doonan & Silas find Sal; Willie rides to Barragong. Machinson apologises to Jim. Council of war; Willie joins.
23. King Charlie and tribe march. Machinson's wounded constable. Jim fires bush.
24. Battle: blacks attack from rear; Rodney escapes on horse, wounded by Doonan. Dalton kills Machinson; Dauntsey shoots Dalton's hand. Seth Sharp captured. Barker's Creek burned.

## PART FIVE: SETTLING DAY (ch25–26)
25. Maud arrives at Wanabeen dying; Sal says "Settling day." Jim goes to Cudgegong; Rodney dies (bleeding) before Jim can kill him; Maud dies holding Willie's hand; Willie not told identity.
26. Jim's settling with Rodney thwarted by death.

## PART SIX: AFTERMATH & SYDNEY CUP (ch27–30)
27. Barker's Creek gang sentenced to death (Bathurst trial). Doonan promoted to sergeant. Chris Shaw inherits Cudgegong; offers Jim management, option to buy. Grey Bird (Neptune's son, by Neptune out of Seamew) entered in Sydney Cup; weight 7st. Dr Tom, Dauntsey travel to Sydney. Doonan bets £5.
28. Randwick; Grey Bird at 100–3 (Jim earlier 50-1 bet, £10,000 to £200). Defiance (favourite, 9st8, Jack Ashton) ; Chris Shaw's Target (Hurley). Molly Corbold meets Jim. Ashton warns.
29. Race: Willie's stirrup leather breaks; Ashton crowds; Grey Bird wins by a neck over Bung Bung (Defiance second by a head). Scale won't go down; bridle fetched; passes. Dr Tom wins £600.
30. Five years on: Grey Bird at Cudgegong stud. Jim buys Cudgegong for £12,000 paid in three years. Doonan marries Sal. Jim marries Molly Corbold (Dauntsey's cousin); Dr Tom poems, practice expands, Swamp Creek gold rush. Willie refuses other rides. Ending: Jim's contentment "autumn of his life."

## KEY NUMBERS/PHRASES
- Swamp Creek Cup £200 + silver cup; First Class 9st7; Neptune 8st7; Willie 7st7 (to 7st, Sydney).
- Potter's Shanty; £5 note; Nation's Bank; Bourke; Barragong (P.M. Adye Dauntsey); Cudgegong 15 miles from Wanabeen; Barker's Creek; Woolloola (tribe camp).
- "Settling day" — recurring motif; Jim's oath; "Try Willie"; "Dr Tom... pulled him through."
- Rodney's memory-loss ruse; Adye Dauntsey spelled out.
- Sydney Cup: Grey Bird won by a neck; odds 100–3 at start, 50-1 earlier; Jim: £12,000 stake.
